headline: Executive order aimed at strengthening the federal supply chain for public health goods and supplies.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with the supply chain for public health needs, meaning how the country gets and keeps the supplies used to respond to health emergencies. No official summary was provided, so the exact steps it orders are not described here. It was signed early in the COVID-19 pandemic.

who_it_affects.how: Based on its title, the order likely directs federal agencies to take steps on how public health supplies are obtained, stored, or distributed.
